step_3_is_setup_before_R_supported.answer: Only via the sphere-stun path; the bare cone knockback is anti-setup for R
step_3_is_setup_before_R_supported.derivation: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.R is targeting='Unit' with targetRange=675 and castTime=0.25. Syndra E 'knocks them back for 400 units and up to 800 units away from Syndra based on proximity'. A 400-800 unit displacement away from Syndra can push the target outside R's 675 unit cast range, so a cone-knockback-first ordering is not a clean setup for R. The sphere path is: spheres 'knock[] back enemies they hit over 70 units' and 'Targets hit are also stunned for 1.25 seconds' — 70 units of displacement stays inside 675 and a 1.25 s stun comfortably covers R's 0.25 s cast. So a CC-setup-before-R edge exists, but the rationale must name the stun to be true; naming nothing (or the knockback) makes the ordering claim unsupported.

independent_computation.step_4_verdict_logic: Correct leaf value = 'E applies stun crowd control - setup before R'. The old value (leaf absent) is also not that: Syndra's E genuinely applies stun/knockback per the cached wiki text, so a CC-setup source line is data-supported and should exist. Neither the old nor the new value equals the value the data supports -> both_wrong. The fix is substitution of the real kind, not deletion of the leaf.
